rule.statement: The rule in Section 5 of the Civil Law Ordinance does not apply to the interest that the Court can order in terms of Section 192 of the Civil Procedure Code on the principal sum and interest thereon from the date of the action to the date of the decree and on the aggregate sum so adjudged from the date of the decree to the date of payment or such earlier date determined by Court.
rule.supporting_quote: However, the rule in Section 5 of the Civil Law Ordinance does not apply to the interest that the Court can order in terms of Section 192 of the Civil Procedure Code on the principal sum and interest thereon from the date of the action to the date of the decree and on the aggregate sum so adjudged from the date of the decree to the date of payment or such earlier date determined by Court.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 5 of the Civil Law Ordinance and Section 192 of the Civil Procedure Code
